fusions.name: Roost Break
fusions.desc: Snaps your cloak wide, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 0.8 seconds. Each has a 30% chance to be turned against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bloodied Tatter
fusions.desc: Spends 5% of your maximum health to fling a blood-soaked tatter of your cloak that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Folded in Night
fusions.desc: Folds your cloak around you and veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. The veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Dusk Mantle
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
